h1: Custom Fitted Dress Shirts for a Polished Look
metaTitle: Custom Fitted Dress Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom fitted dress shirts in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for teams seeking a sharp, tailored appearance.
introHtml: Fitted dress shirts offer a modern silhouette that flatters a range of body types while maintaining a professional appearance. Unlike standard cuts, fitted shirts have slightly tapered waists and narrower shoulders, reducing excess fabric for a cleaner line. They work well for trade show staff, sales teams, or any group where you want a polished, uniform look without custom tailoring. Decorate with left-chest embroidery or a subtle logo on the collar for a refined finish.
heroAltText: Group of people wearing custom fitted dress shirts with embroidered logos, showing a tailored fit.
